verdicts.reason: A and B look the same as far as I can tell. In both, the PlayStation-symbol logo row has shrunk to a tiny strip in the top-left corner and no longer works as the hero image. The pink question is squeezed into a narrow left column with ragged wraps ('CANNOT' sits alone on its line). The 3-day event body copy is very small at 300x250 and hard to read, and the URL is jammed near the bottom edge. Both are cramped two-column layouts with the same flaws.
